title: Silent Sanctuary turns 24 years of classic hits into a 'Gabi ng Lambing'
summary: A band that stuck through it all. For 24 years, Silent Sanctuary has been there for the kilig, the hugot, and every heartbreak in between. On October 25, the Mall of Asia Arena came alive as the band…
